title: Fields a message can contain
body_md:
Depending on the incident and the switch position, a message can contain the following information:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| GPS | If the antenna is in standby, it is reactivated automatically in the event of an incident. |
| UTC | Time of the incident in coordinated universal time. |
| Pos | Current vehicle position; the format depends on the mobile device. |
| Speed | Current speed of the vehicle. |
